axis: T-215 limb 1: the `replay` seed with the echoed error stripped of the name (`error: tool not found`, same message, same position) and the same name-free echo used for every defect the loop provokes - so the difference against `replay` is the verbatim NAME in the echo, not the presence of an echo and not the seeded assistant turn (both carry it)

instrument_allowance.rule: BUG-1081/D-3203: floor(per_turn_budget_s * decode_tps(model)) from config/agent_context.yaml#turn_budget - never a literal

retry_guard.rule: a turn whose owed call the engine's parser ate is RE-ASKED with a nudge that NAMES the missing call - never byte-identically, because R7 pins temperature 0.0 and an identical prompt is a deterministic replay of the same refused header (measured 2026-10-27: 6 identical re-issues recovered 0 of 3); an allowance, a silent stop or a declined call is NEVER retried

not_tested: enable_thinking=False on a harmony model that emits an analysis channel anyway (a server-side setting this fixture never changes)
the <|channel|>json where <|constrain|>json belongs token confusion: the marker is REPLAYED as a name tail, never produced by the model under observation

which HALF of the seeded pair teaches the copy: `blank-echo` now separates the verbatim NAME in the echo from the seeded assistant turn, but the FULLY UNBALANCED transcript (an assistant tool_call with NO tool response at all) is a different axis - it changes structure as well as content, and an engine that refuses it would return a transport error, not a reading

rows.stop_reason: stopped early: the turn spent its whole token allowance (finish_reason=length) and returned no content - the instrument cannot see this model at this allowance, so this is UNMEASURED, not a FAIL
rows.detail: the turn spent its whole token allowance (finish_reason=length) and returned no content - the instrument cannot see this model at this allowance, so this is UNMEASURED, not a FAIL
